featured_reviews.name: JYOTI PRAJAPATI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Horrible Experience! Extremely Rude Staff (Mr. Vishal & Ajay ringe) and worst Management!

I had one of the worst shopping experiences of my life at Smart Sahakari Bhandar. I did grocery shopping worth ₹6200, and as per their own policy, customers should receive 1 kg of sugar for every ₹2500 spent. That clearly means I was entitled to 2 kg of sugar. However, after scanning all my items, the cashier casually told me there was no sugar available and completed the billing.

Later, I clearly saw sugar available at another counter and asked her to provide it since I had already crossed the billing amount. She bluntly refused, saying nothing could be done once the bill was generated. Absolutely ridiculous!

Then the store head, Vishal, came over and behaved extremely rudely and unprofessionally. Instead of resolving the issue, he started arguing with us as if we were begging for something free. He had no idea how to talk to customers and showed zero respect or accountability. We were made to stand there and argue for more than 30 minutes for a mistake that was entirely theirs.

Finally, after wasting so much of our time, he created a voucher, refunded the amount, and regenerated the bill. This entire drama could have been avoided if the staff and management had even basic customer-handling skills.

The staff here is arrogant, rude, and completely clueless about customer service. The management is pathetic and doesn’t know how to honor their own offers.

featured_reviews.name: Rennie Matthews
featured_reviews.review_text:
The only place in Goregaon East, where you can get most of the grocery stuff, including imported, which you can't find anywhere else. The one stop where you get almost everything you need and not free on going to multiple shops.
You get different varieties to spoil you or put you in a good dilemma on which one to select.
You can go around the shop at ease and search what you need.
The staff is very helpful and you don't need to search for anything.
The only negative point is they are at the mercy of their distributor, who decides when to deliver something which is out of stock.
It's open from 8 am - 11 pm, in all days except on Janmastami.
They sell at discounted rates almost all MRP stuff, except the local or loose items.
Their popularity is seen by the good crowd all the time.
There's a vegetable and fruits shop just outside and it too keeps everything you need.
So, both shopping is taken care of. Both have card swipe avd UPI.
Om Mart also accepts Sodexo for those who use it (only for food items).
No parking availablity and towing worry across Gokuldham is something no one talks of.

Please don't ever consider this place for any purchase.

featured_reviews.name: Pushkar Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is one of the best well-known place at Ashok Nagar, (Paranjape Scheme,) Vazira Naka, Borivali.

Basically here you will get the best Maharashtrian food delicacy.  Especially for festive season.  They make & deliver on counter only the best authentic home made items at reasonable rates on counter + made to order too.

The owner Mr.Yogesh Deshpande is a very soft spoken gentleman who will guide you to choose the right thing not only for the value for money but treat ti your test buds too.

Their customer service and time saving efforts are worth appreciating. During various festivals they provide you pre order booking forms which ensures that you get an assured delivery of Authentic Good Maharashtrian Sweets & Snacks without any hassle.

The staff here is also quick & customer friendly too.

A decades old shop has recently started their second branch at Sunil Nagar Dombivli (East) too. And now the entire Deshpande family is service to customers only for authentic good quality snacks.

featured_reviews.name: Delilah Gonsalves
featured_reviews.review_text: A small and humble store, with sweet staff to assist and help you in choosing basis your preference. Must try the laddoos with minimal sugar not compromising the taste.

featured_reviews.name: Vandy
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the best shop for typical maharashtrian items at Vazira Naka, Borivali West. All types of papad is the speciality of the shop. There are lot of varities of snacks, spices, pickles etc. Service is best.

featured_reviews.name: Innovating Reading and Taste On the Go Blog
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is one of the best places at Ashok Nagar, (Paranjape Scheme,) Vazira Naka, Borivali for anyone but a hard core Marathi Manoos in particular. A variety of Maharashtrian food delicacies ranging from Masale, Pohe to Puran Poli and Tel Poli. They do accept pre-orders for Diwali and Holi.
A must try is the "Basoondi" from Narsobachi Wadi.

featured_reviews.name: Aditi Prabhu
featured_reviews.review_text:

It is my go to shop.
